Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent made an error in the first step by misinterpreting the information from the Wikipedia excerpt, which incorrectly stated that the 1974 Texas Tech Red Raiders football team represented Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center. This initial misattribution led to repeated attempts to verify the incorrect information, instead of confirming that the team represented Texas Tech University, the well-known public research university in Lubbock. This caused a cycle of incorrect verification attempts without addressing the root of the error.
